A sniglet namer that asks Claude

Source: R/suggest-names.R
claudeNamer.Rd

Makes the model function suggestSnigletNames() needs from the Anthropic Messages API: each call sends one sniglet's crops and the prompt, and returns the text of the reply. Every call is billed to the API key's account; one call is made per sniglet, plus one for every name that has to be asked for again.

Usage

claudeNamer(
  model = "claude-opus-5-5",
  apiKey = Sys.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"),
  maxTokens = 16000,
  effort = NULL,
  retries = 3,
  timeout = 120,
  url = "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages",
  fallback = FALSE
)

Arguments

model

The model to ask. It has to accept images.

apiKey

The API key. By default the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.

maxTokens

The most tokens a reply may use. Current models think before they answer and the thinking counts, so leave room for it; only the tokens actually used are billed.

effort

Optional effort level ("low", "medium", "high", ...) for models that take one; "low" is plenty for naming and costs less. By default it is not sent and the model's own default applies.

retries

How many times to try again after a rate limit or a server error.

timeout

Seconds to wait for a reply.

url

The API endpoint.

fallback

TRUE to let the API answer with another model when the one asked declines (its safety classifiers can misjudge a harmless photo). This sends fallbacks = "default" with the beta header server-side-fallback-2026-07-01, which the Anthropic API takes but not every platform that serves Claude; by default it is not sent and a declined request is reported on that sniglet's row.

Value

A function function(images, prompt) returning the reply's text.

Details

A rate limit (HTTP 429), an overloaded service (529) or a server or connection error is tried again up to retries times, waiting as long as the API asks. Any other error stops that one call with the API's message, which suggestSnigletNames() reports for that sniglet before carrying on with the next. So does a reply the model declined to give (stop reason "refusal") and one that ran out of tokens ("max_tokens").

Images

The API takes JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP images of at most 5 MB each (as base64; some platforms allow more), and reads small images poorly. With the magick package installed, crops larger than 2000 pixels or 5 MB are scaled down before they are sent and crops smaller than 200 pixels are enlarged. Without it they are sent as they are, and a crop over 5 MB stops that call with a message. A call with more than 100 images is refused, and with many large crops each is scaled down further so that the request stays under the API's 32 MB.

See also

suggestSnigletNames()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# needs an API key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; the calls are billed to it
key <- patchExemplars(vision, key, images)
suggestSnigletNames(key, claudeNamer(), file = "names.csv")
# ... review names.csv ...
key <- renameSniglets(key, "names.csv")
} # }
